protection_assessment.removable_module: Reference is a fixed-load lamp circuit. Bulk output capacitor can dump charge directly into a newly connected LED module independent of U1 regulation. No demonstrated energized-reconnect limit or user-accessible interface safety follows.
protection_assessment.single_fault: On-chip protections share one IC; MOSFET D-S short/sense-divider failure can defeat regulation/OVP. Reference normal/short/surge tests are not complete abnormal single-fault certification. Required response must be assessed as a complete lamp with fuse/component/containment behavior. Do not claim two independent protection channels.
